channel.title: Business Bay Developments — Journal
channel.description: Sourced, dated guidance on Egyptian real estate for international buyers — foreign ownership, residency, title registration, costs and the New Administrative Capital.

item.title: The New Administrative Capital: What Is Actually Built and Operating
item.description: A sourced, dated status report on Egypt's New Administrative Capital — what has relocated, who lives there, what connects it to Cairo, and where published figures disagree.

item.title: How to Check an Egyptian Developer Before You Buy: A Due Diligence Checklist
item.description: Twelve questions to ask any Egyptian developer before signing — on licensing, land title, delivery record, registration, payment protection and contract terms.

item.title: New Administrative Capital, New Cairo or the Coast? Where International Buyers Should Look
item.description: A balanced comparison of Egypt's main property destinations for international buyers — market maturity, infrastructure, liquidity and the trade-offs of each.

item.title: How to Buy Property in Egypt Without Flying to Cairo
item.description: The full remote purchase process for overseas buyers — power of attorney, documentation, payment sequence and handover — and where it usually goes wrong.

item.title: What Does It Actually Cost to Buy and Own Property in Egypt?
item.description: Purchase price is not total cost. Registration fees, annual property tax, VAT, service charges and the 2.5% disposal tax on sale, explained for foreign buyers.

item.title: Moving Money Into Egypt — and Out Again: A Foreign Buyer's Guide
item.description: How foreign buyers transfer funds into Egypt, why the route matters for residency, what devaluation means for a hard-currency earner, and what to know about getting proceeds out.

item.title: Green Contract or Nothing: Understanding Property Title Registration in Egypt
item.description: A sales contract and a registered title are not the same thing in Egypt, and the difference decides whether you can get residency, sell, or borrow against your property.

item.title: Does Buying Property in Egypt Get You Residency? What the Rules Say
item.description: Property purchase can qualify a foreign buyer for Egyptian residency. The thresholds are widely misreported. Here is what we could verify, and what we could not.

item.title: Can Foreigners Own Property in Egypt? The Rules, the Limits, and the Five-Year Restriction
item.description: Foreigners can own property in Egypt, but the law sets limits on how many units, how large, and — critically — when you are allowed to sell. Here is what Law 230 of 1996 actually says.

item.title: Buying Property in Egypt's New Administrative Capital: A Guide for International Buyers
item.description: Ownership law, residency, title, currency, cost and process — the complete picture for a foreign buyer considering Egypt's New Administrative Capital.
